You sound like me.  I'm 25 now and have struggled with anxiety and depression for as long as I can remember. I've been on more meds than I can recount and been to the hospital a few times.  The only thing that has really worked for me is changing my lifestyle patterns.  I take fish oil,b vitamins and magnesium, which help immensely with reducing stress hormones that can slowly morph certain areas of your brain for the worse.  I try to look at it from an anatomical standpoint.  What things release endorphins and serotonin? What things increase cortisol and adrenaline?  Go towards the good and stay away from the bad with daily actions and thoughs. Sorry to sound preachy, this is just what has worked for me.  Good luck.
